announcements.headline: Share Issuance and new Share Option Plan adoption
announcements.insight: Hamak Gold Limited adopts a new share option plan following its interim results. This governance change may align management incentives with recent operational updates.

announcements.headline: Director Dealing
announcements.insight: Director dealings are routine governance updates. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for material corporate actions following the recent interim results.

announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim Results are released following the admission of new shares in August and the sale of Bitcoin to support the Akoko PEA. Shareholders should monitor how these funding activities impact the project's progress.

announcements.headline: Sale of 8 Bitcoin Supports Advancing of Akoko PEA
announcements.insight: Hamak Gold Limited has appointed Snowden Optiro for the Akoko PEA, following the maiden resource announcement in July. This advances the project towards a preliminary economic assessment.

announcements.headline: Correction re. Warrant Exchange Offer
announcements.insight: Hamak Gold Limited issued a correction to its warrant exchange offer. This follows the admission of new ordinary shares in August.

announcements.headline: Admission of New Ordinary Shares
announcements.insight: Admission of new shares follows the warrant exchange offer in July. This likely reflects the conversion of tendered warrants into equity.

announcements.headline: Snowden Optiro Selected for Akoko PEA
announcements.insight: Following the maiden resource announcement in July, Hamak Gold Limited has selected Optiro for an Akoko PEA. This advances the project's development status.

announcements.headline: Maiden Independent 43-101 Resource at Akoko
announcements.insight: This resource update follows recent warrant cancellations. Shareholders should monitor how this geological data influences future capital decisions.

announcements.headline: 179,906,090 Warrants Tendered for Cancellation
announcements.insight: Following the July offer, warrants have been tendered for cancellation. This reduces share count, potentially increasing value for remaining holders.

announcements.headline: Warrant Exchange Offer: Threshold Met
announcements.insight: The warrant exchange threshold is met following the July proposal. This advances the capital raise process initiated earlier in the month.

announcements.headline: Notice to Eligible Warrant Holders
announcements.insight: Following the July proposal, this notice advances the warrant exchange offer. Eligible holders must act to participate in the capital restructuring.

announcements.headline: Statement regarding investment in Vaultz Capital
announcements.insight: Hamak Gold Limited NPV (DI) (HAMA) announces an investment in Vaultz Capital. This follows recent funding and drilling updates.

announcements.headline: Proposed Warrant Exchange Offer
announcements.insight: This follows the July funding package. Shareholders should watch for court sanction of this exchange.

announcements.headline: £200,000 Subscription & Appointment of Adviser
announcements.insight: This follows the July funding package, indicating continued capital raising efforts. An adviser has been appointed to manage the £200,000 subscription.

announcements.headline: Further High-Grade Drilling Results at Akoko
announcements.insight: Further high-grade drilling results at Akoko follow the amended funding package. This suggests operational progress supported by recent capital raising.

announcements.headline: £1.66 million Amended Funding Package
announcements.insight: The amended funding package follows the June AGM results. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent capital raising steps.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the results of the Annual General Meeting. This filing confirms the outcome of the recent shareholder vote.
